messages.label: Sent
messages.subject: Live entertainment – Jake Essex (Elvis & Rock ’n’ Roll)
messages.body:
Hi,

My name is Natalie and I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake performs a high-energy classic Rock ’n’ Roll show with a strong Elvis element – he’s not a typical Elvis impersonator. The first half covers Bobby Darin, Sinatra, Johnny Cash, Buddy Holly, Roy Orbison and more, before moving into a full Elvis set that takes the audience through the years.

He already works regularly across Essex, East & South London and Kent, and is now expanding into West London. He has some availability left this year and is also taking bookings for 2027.

Fully self-contained with his own PA.

Pricing:
• 2 × 1 hour – £250 cash / £280 through the books
• 3 × 45 mins – £350 cash / £380 through the books

Footage here: www.instagram.com/jakeessexmusic

If you have any suitable dates or would like more information, just let me know.

Best regards,
Natalie
on behalf of Jake Essex Music

messages.label: Their reply
messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for La Casa Vecchia?
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry for the slow reply. Jake sounds like a good fit for us.

Saturdays through to Christmas are all taken by private parties, but Sundays are open - the 18th or 25th of October, or the 8th or 15th of November. We pause for December, and the new year is largely open, Saturdays included.

The way it works for a new act is the same as on our site (https://www.70-72thepantiles.co.uk/play-at-the-grey-lady/): rather than a fee, you keep every penny of the ticket money, and there's no venue hire fee. What we need from you in return is the audience. You send me a poster and a short description, we put the night up on our site and sell the tickets (or you sell them yourself if you'd rather), and we push it on our channels - but your own following is what fills the room, so we'd need you promoting it hard too. The one condition is that the audience spends at least £300 on food and drink on a Sunday to Thursday, or £1,200 on a Friday or Saturday.

If the first night goes well, we're happy to talk about a share of the bar and food takings for the next one. We'd rather build it up together.

If one of those dates suits Jake, let me know which and I'll hold it.

Thanks,
Caio

Sorry about that. You're right to ask for a clear figure.

messages.subject: Thanks for emailing the Peckham Liberal Club Re: Jake Essex for Peckham Liberal Club?
messages.body:
Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch

If you are interested in being a member of the club the best thing to do is head down to us at 24 Elm Grove, Peckham, and buzz the door. Ask to come and have a look at the club, and say you are interested in becoming a member. Charles Coote is the president and he will give you an application form. Membership costs £20 a year and you need the signatures of two existing members.

If you are enquiring about booking the club for an event then please contact our events manager Janice Brittain in the first instance - you can reach her at the club on 020 7639 1093 or 07527 912 119 (not on Tuesdays). this is the best way to book or check availability

More information on our venue is available here: http://www.peckhamliberalclub.org/venue-hire

Web and Social Media manager
Peckham Liberal Club
24 Elm Grove, SE15 5DE
